exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.recurrence: H_t = Q @ H_(t-1), then set diag(H_t)=1 for t=1..70
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.semantics: H_t[s,j] is cumulative first-passage support for target j from unit source s under the same sub-stochastic transition operator
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.compatibility_target_rule: every non-source ever-positive calibration node must have final-step support > 0

response_endpoint_payload.unit: eligible parent Transect visit x recorded Thalassia testudinum detection among linked child Point events
response_endpoint_payload.positive_rule: at least one linked child Point occurrence row has exact scientificName Thalassia testudinum and occurrenceStatus present
response_endpoint_payload.negative_rule: no linked exact focal present occurrence on an otherwise frozen eligible parent Transect visit

external_feature_payload.numeric_preprocessing: required numeric passthrough; optional depth_min_m/depth_median_m/depth_max_m calibration-median plus missing indicator
external_feature_payload.categorical_preprocessing: water_body calibration-only lexicographic one-hot levels plus __UNSEEN__; missing forbidden

eog_feature_payload.calibration_occurrence_definition: stable node is positive iff any calibration candidate visit at that node is focal-positive across the full frozen survey history
eog_feature_payload.training_self_exclusion: remove the training row's entire stable node from the ever-positive occurrence set before constructing its Layer-B row

placebo_payload.permutation: within each outer fold, independently per real Layer-B column, separately for calibration and heldout candidate rows, using numpy.random.default_rng(seed)
